_comment: Pre-baked fallback image library — NOT POPULATED (2026-08-25). For the offline Tramokyo kiosk this is fine: the pre-harvested pack imagery (public/tramokyo-pack/images/journeys) is the guaranteed backbone and this library never triggers. It only matters for an ONLINE /installation kiosk when fal.ai is unreachable for 3+ consecutive frames — then the kiosk picks a random image from the journey's bucket below instead of freezing on the last frame. To populate: drop pre-rendered JPGs/PNGs into /public/installation-fallback/<journey-id>/ and list their public paths under the matching key (~30 per journey reads naturally). Keys are journey ids as seen by the visualizer: built-ins by slug (current Snowflake program: first-snow, inferno, ghost), Welcome Home path journeys by their DB row uuid. Empty bucket = no fallback for that journey (freeze on last frame, default behavior).
